scope: Complete static medium-fi exterior; original detailed draft remains reproducible. Ten tapered right-angle flanges, pointed east entrance, two steps, recessed wood inner door, three proportional brick entrance niches, ten distinct relief-stroke panels per inscription band, corbelled neck and closed roof light remain. The 52.844 m tip follows the 2010 laser scan rather than the erroneous 72 m OSM tag. Curved bays and cone interpolate measured sections; anomalous scan-table diameters are averaged. A thin 2 cm circular pavement datum corrects the original 40 cm disc that hid the two access steps; the pavement thickness and inner spandrel/niche/door geometry are approximate, not a conservation survey. Relief strokes interpret nomination figures 67–76 individually but do not certify a readable epigraphic transcription; upper and lower bands reuse that sequence, while exact letter damage and plaster are averaged. Roof light retains the published height and base datum with approximate splayed width and reveal. Hidden roof construction and chamber are excluded from this exterior scope; the nomination itself rejects a simple assumed double-shell construction. Mound, park paths, ramps, furniture and buried foundations are separate terrain/site context. Host terrain must supply the mound summit; no fixed 10 m offset is added atop unknown terrain. Retained exact-QID OSM center is approximate. Published east entrance gives cardinal orientation with about 10 degrees uncertainty, not surveyed azimuth. Footprint replacement is disabled.
placementEvidence: Nomination printed pages 66–67 identify the east entrance. Native +Z maps east at heading pi/2, and native +X maps north. Actual north-up Google satellite inspected on 2026-10-09 shows the tower centrally on the mound with eastward park approaches. A partly missing eastern tile and the tall roof/shadow prevent a precise door survey. Retained Q606763 / way 328041889 supplies approximate identity and center. The closed source-local base circle is an original measured-envelope interpretation, not a fresh OSM download. Fine azimuth and actual host DEM fit remain unmeasured.
